import json, os, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

root = Path(r'E:\Projects\RL-LAM-ScanOpt')
case_dir = root / 'cae_model' / 'stage3_true_variable_N_probe60_v01' / 'N24' / 'N24_A07_regular_jump_coprime'
out_dir = root / 'outputs' / 'stage3_cae_probe60_generation'
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
keywords = ['abaqus','standard','explicit','pre','package','solver','analysis','abq']

ps = r'''
$procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine,CreationDate
$procs | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
'''
cp = subprocess.run(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command',ps], capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace')
try:
    proc_data = json.loads(cp.stdout) if cp.stdout.strip() else []
except Exception:
    proc_data = []
if isinstance(proc_data, dict): proc_data = [proc_data]
matched=[]
case_hit=[]
case_str = str(case_dir).lower()
job = 'j2d_n24_n24_a07_regular_jump_coprime'
for p in proc_data:
    name = str(p.get('Name',''))
    cmd = str(p.get('CommandLine','') or '')
    blob = (name + ' ' + cmd).lower()
    if any(k in blob for k in keywords):
        matched.append(p)
    if case_str in blob or job in blob:
        case_hit.append(p)

files = {}
for ext in ['inp','cae','jnl','odb','sim','sta','dat','msg','lck','prt','com','log','res','mdl','stt']:
    paths = sorted(case_dir.glob(f'*.{ext}'))
    files[ext] = [{'path': str(p), 'size': p.stat().st_size, 'mtime': datetime.fromtimestamp(p.stat().st_mtime).isoformat(timespec='seconds')} for p in paths]

summary = {
    'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds'),
    'case_dir': str(case_dir),
    'process_audit_command_returncode': cp.returncode,
    'process_audit_stderr': cp.stderr[-2000:],
    'matched_abaqus_related_processes': matched,
    'matched_case_processes': case_hit,
    'abaqus_related_process_count': len(matched),
    'case_process_count': len(case_hit),
    'file_inventory': files,
    'lck_count': len(files['lck']),
}
path = out_dir / 'N24_A07_process_lock_audit.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'abaqus_related_process_count': len(matched), 'case_process_count': len(case_hit), 'lck_count': len(files['lck']), 'audit_path': str(path), 'matched': matched[:10], 'case_matched': case_hit}, indent=2))
'@ | & \"D:\XianLab\envs\conda\torch-gpu\python.exe\" -"
